summary: Baan Tepa is an immersive seven-course contemporary Thai dinner built around seasonal local ingredients, garden produce and low-waste cooking. The restaurant has reopened with its Baan Tepa 2.0 menu; the official booking page lists that menu through February 28, 2027, so it is a live December 2026 option.
whyGo: A strong choice for a planned special-occasion dinner that explores Thai ingredients and techniques through a polished tasting menu.
The chef-led presentation includes ingredient introductions, and Michelin describes its farm-to-table sourcing and waste-conscious approach.
bestFor: Food-focused travelers who enjoy long, set-menu dinners and are comfortable with an upscale price.
Couples, small groups and solo diners; the restaurant accepts solo bookings, with limited availability.
skipIf: You want an inexpensive, casual or à la carte meal, or need a short dinner close to central Bangkok.
You are vegetarian or vegan, avoid seafood, gluten, dairy, garlic or onion; the restaurant says it cannot accommodate these restrictions.
duration: Allow about 2.5 hours for the seven-course dinner; arrive promptly for the chosen 18:00, 19:00 or 20:00 seating.
cost: The official booking calendar lists the Baan Tepa 2.0 menu at THB 8,004 per person including service and tax (as listed on 2026-10-17). Pairings cost extra; recheck the calendar for your date.
hours: Dinner Wednesday–Sunday, 18:00–23:00; seatings at 18:00, 19:00 and 20:00. Closed Monday and Tuesday. The outdoor Tepa Garden café is temporarily closed.
bestTime: Choose a date when the 2.0 menu is offered and reserve an early seating if you want a less-late finish. December dates can be busy; confirm holiday service directly.
gettingThere: At 561 Ramkhamhaeng Road in Bang Kapi, east of the main tourist districts. A taxi or ride-hail directly to the address is the simplest plan; public transport requires a last-mile connection. Allow extra time for Bangkok traffic and arrange the return ride before dinner ends.
booking: Book through the restaurant's TableCheck page; advance reservations open up to 60 days ahead and a 50% menu-price deposit is required. The calendar currently lists Baan Tepa 2.0 dates from October 17, 2026 through February 28, 2027, excluding October 16. Check December availability, holiday closures, menu and deposit terms when your booking window opens. Solo bookings are accepted online with limited seats; the official contact page gives email and phone for questions.
accessibility: The official site and booking information reviewed do not describe step-free access, accessible toilets or other mobility provisions. Contact the restaurant before booking if access needs matter; access at the venue is unverified.
practicalTips: Read the dietary policy before paying: the restaurant lists several restrictions it cannot accommodate and requests other needs at least seven days ahead.
Smart casual dress; the restaurant asks guests not to wear shorts, sleeveless tops or flip-flops.
Children must be at least 12 and able to enjoy the full tasting menu; there is no children's à la carte menu.
Cancellation refunds are available more than seven days ahead; within seven days the deposit is non-refundable, according to the restaurant's policy.
decemberNotes: The official booking calendar, checked October 17, 2026, lists the Baan Tepa 2.0 menu through February 28, 2027, including December, at THB 8,004 net. It lists Wednesday–Sunday dinner service. Christmas/New Year hours or special menus are not specified, so confirm your exact date; reserve once the 60-day window opens.
uncertainties: December holiday opening dates and any special menu or pricing may change.
Accessibility facilities are not documented in the official information reviewed.
Traffic and the best public-transport last-mile option depend on the starting point and time of day.
